0.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_000
0.description: With all of the recent developments, I have been thinking about how best to utilize this area.

1.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_005
1.description: The enclave has welcomed a number of former imperial conscripts, including several Lupin.

2.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_006
2.description: Now that we have so many willing and able workers, it is hard to decide what they should all be doing.

4.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_011
4.description: Kozakura has told me all about you. The two of us are childhood friends and she keeps me informed on the activities of the Shazenkai.

5.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_012
5.description: I am Mauto, head of the enclave guard.

6.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_013
6.description: As you can see, we are in the midst of constructing our new base of operations. It will be used primarily as a place to train when we are not on duty.

7.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_014
7.description: Our patrols help to ensure that no roaming beasts make their way inside. We also inspect various areas of the enclave, identifying places where accidents might occur. Although with all the building work, practically everywhere contains a hazard of some sort.

8.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_VIGILANTE00528A_000_015
8.description: Mauto! Can we have a word?

9.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_016
9.description: Very well, provided you keep it brief.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_VIGILANTE00528A_000_017
10.description: We were wondering─when are we supposed to change shifts?

11.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_018
11.description: I thought I made this clear─ Every half a bell!

12.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_VIGILANTE00528B_000_019
12.description: Gah! In that case, we have some apologizing to do!

13.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_020
13.description: Perhaps I should revise the schedule. How do you measure half a bell anyway?

14.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_021
14.description: Ahem. Until recently, Hakuro and his troops patrolled the enclave. Now, they have been asked to forgo that in order to deal with more urgent concerns. After all, their role is to protect the whole of Doma, not just the enclave.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_022
15.description: As such, we citizens must find a means to protect ourselves!

16.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_023
16.description: That is our reason for forming the enclave guard.

17.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_024
17.description: Most of our members were forced to serve the Empire during the occupation, so they were glad to finally have the opportunity to do something for Doma's sake.

18.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_025
18.description: Being conscripted soldiers, they were given some degree of training. They would have been used as little more than cannon fodder in the event of actual combat, though. But at least they were worthy of being chosen...

19.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_026
19.description: You see, I am not the biggest of Lupin, and I have always suffered from a weakness in the legs. Normally, being small and light makes one nimble, but not in my case...

20.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_027
20.description: It did mean, however, that I was spared from conscription. Not that being left behind was much easier. Most of my friends were taken away, while I was powerless to help them. Part of me was glad that I could stay here, which made me realize that deep down I was naught but a coward.

21.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_028
21.description: One thing I gained─perhaps the only thing─was an unrivaled knowledge of the nooks and crannies of the enclave. All that scurrying around trying to avoid the Garleans meant I knew all of the best hiding places!

22.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_029
22.description: With the imperials gone, I started showing these spots to the Doman soldiers on patrol, and before long, they had put me in charge of the enclave guard! We are only a group of volunteers, but it is a great honor.

23.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_030
23.description: Now that I am finally able to make myself useful, I want to do everything in my power to repay the trust they have shown me. And your donations will not go to waste, I promise!

24.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_SYSTEM_000_031
24.description: Construction of the Enclave Barracks is underway, as a dedicated collective of citizens patrols the streets.

25.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_SYSTEM_000_032
25.description: As you continue to contribute to the Shazenkai and the reconstruction effort, in what other ways might the Doman Enclave grow and change?

26.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_035
26.description: Our recruits may be rather rough around the edges, yet each and every one of them is committed to our cause. They simply need more time to adjust to their new roles.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_041
28.description: I hope you like what we have done with the barracks. It has come a long way, I am sure you will agree.

29.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_042
29.description: Even I am amazed we managed to get it finished so quickly, what with all of our patrolling and assisting people with their troubles.

30.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_043
30.description: Your donations were so generous that we were able to afford new weapons.

31.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_044
31.description: Thankfully, beyond seeing off the odd creature that wanders too close to the perimeter walls, we have had little cause to use them.

32.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_045
32.description: We also have the equipment necessary to put out fires and detain criminals. Again, nothing of that nature has occurred so far, much to our relief. There is one missing cat that still eludes us, however.

33.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_046
33.description: It is bound to show up soon! And may I say, I am amazed at the lengths to which you are willing to go to help the enclave.

34.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_047
34.description: The real reason that we came here, however, is to deliver a message. There was a missive addressed to you, Mauty.

35.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_048
35.description: I...I told you never to call me by that name!

36.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_049
36.description: Never mind that─ It is from Lord Hien himself. Simply put, he wishes to give the enclave guard official recognition, in light of your service to the kingdom of Doma.

38.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_051
38.description: Yes, it is! Lord Hien pays more attention to what goes on around here than you realize.

39.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_052
39.description: Not content to rely on hearsay, he has shown a personal interest in the activities of the enclave guard, their patrols, and so on.

40.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_053
40.description: He knows full well how committed and diligent you have all been, and thought that this is no more than you deserve.

41.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_054
41.description: We never strove to be more than a group of well-organized volunteers, so this comes as something of a surprise!

42.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_055
42.description: Many of us have families to support and jobs to hold down, so I only ask our members to contribute what time they can spare. If we were formally in the employ of the kingdom, we could dedicate ourselves wholly to the enclave guard.

43.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_056
43.description: Yes, the more I think on it, the more I realize what a privilege this truly is.

44.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_057
44.description: Thank you <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, Kozakura. It is your generosity and hard work that have made this possible.

45.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_058
45.description: I intend to prove that your faith in us was not misplaced!

46.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_VIGILANTE00528B_000_059
46.description: Mauto! Those Budugan men have infiltrated the Kienkan!

48.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_061
48.description: Apprehend the intruders! I want them alive and preferably unharmed! One of you stay here─ I will prepare some choice words for you to deliver to those scoundrels.

49.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_VIGILANTE00528A_100_061
49.description: I'll gather some men and go on ahead! Once the Buduga have been trussed up and given a severe telling-off, they will know better than to try any of their antics again!

50.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_062
50.description: Would you excuse us for a few moments?

51.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_063
51.description: I never knew he had it in him to become such a respected leader.

52.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_064
52.description: The Enclave Barracks are exactly what this place needed and Mauto has surpassed all expectations.

53.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_065
53.description: Now that the important matter of protecting the citizenry appears to have been addressed, I have another proposal for you.

54.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_066
54.description: I expect you have seen the enormous imperial structure by the docks.

55.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_067
55.description: Although it has for the most part been demolished, the watchtower still looms ominously over the enclave, an unpleasant reminder of the occupation.

56.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_068
56.description: Since the efforts of the Shazenkai have predominantly focused on establishing an acceptable standard of living for our people, cases such as this have not received much attention until now.

57.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_069
57.description: Fortunately, we are now in a position to divert donations to replacing the Garlean-built tower with one of our own, so that we may cast a watchful eye across the One River and the surrounding region.

58.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_KOZAKURA_000_070
58.description: If you are able to continue your contributions, it would be immensely beneficial for the enclave.

59.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_071
59.description: And don't rough them up too much! Ihase needs their help in the paddy fields!

60.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_072
60.description: Sorry about that. Did I hear you mention building a new watchtower? If you need people to man it, look no further than the enclave guard!

62.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_SYSTEM_000_074
62.description: Now that the Enclave Barracks is complete, the Shazenkai aims to further improve security by replacing the imperial watchtower with one of Doman design.

63.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_SYSTEM_000_075
63.description: Furthermore, as a result of the enclave's expansion, the rate of gratuities paid for donations has increased, as well as the weekly budget.

64.name: TEXT_CTSDOMRECONSTRUCTMAUTO_00528_MAUTO_000_080
64.description: The more the enclave grows, the more it will attract attention from criminals, invaders and the like. But fear not─we will keep the people safe.
